title: A chain lost on a restart before the write starts again once for the same action; one lost while placing does not
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm both tests named in run.tests report ok.
expect: A chain lost while preparing is restarted once by the same action, which stays queued.
Lost a second time, it is not restarted again and the build ends with qa.reason LOST_ON_RESTART.
A chain lost while placing on the site is never restarted by itself and ends with qa.reason LOST_ON_RESTART.

tests: a chain lost on a restart before the write starts again once, by the same action
a chain lost while placing on the site is never started again by itself
